name: Vis Svokunol
description: A loxodon veteran and Asterion's childhood caretaker, accused of being a mercenary and put to death in a stockade.

timeline.summary: Asterion tells how his caretaker Vis was arrested in Tarangrad and left to die in a stockade (flashback).
timeline.quote: By the time I reached Tarangrad, it was too late.

relations.note: Teutamos condemned Vis to death under the law.
relations.quote: When I confronted him, he wouldn't give me an answer as to why he condemned Vis to death

pages_say.description: A loxodon veteran and Asterion's childhood caretaker, accused of being a mercenary and put to death in a stockade.
